// Generated companion for the private P05 email-field adaptation.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// EmailField contains presentation data, not email validation or persistence.
// Error empty selects the authored neutral state; nonempty selects source styling.
// The app owns unique IDs, form handlers, authoritative errors and focus policy.
type EmailField struct {
	ID, Name, Label, Value, Placeholder, Error string
	Required, Autofocus bool
}

// NewEmailField checks presentation bounds before rendering any response bytes.
// Invalid email values are deliberately accepted, so a rejection can retain input.
func NewEmailField(data EmailField) (templ.Component, error) {
	if !emailFieldIdentifier(data.ID) || !emailFieldIdentifier(data.Name) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("email field: invalid ID or Name")
	}
	for _, field := range []struct { name, value string; limit int; required bool }{
		{"Label", data.Label, 200, true}, {"Value", data.Value, 4096, false},
		{"Placeholder", data.Placeholder, 320, false}, {"Error", data.Error, 1000, false},
	} {
		if len(field.value) > field.limit || !utf8.ValidString(field.value) ||
			(field.required && strings.TrimSpace(field.value) == "") ||
			(field.name == "Error" && field.value != "" && strings.TrimSpace(field.value) == "") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("email field: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
		for _, r := range field.value {
			if unicode.IsControl(r) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("email field: invalid %s", field.name) }
		}
	}
	return emailField(data), nil
}

func emailFieldIdentifier(s string) bool {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 64 { return false }
	for i, c := range []byte(s) {
		letter := c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'
		if !letter && (i == 0 || !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.')) { return false }
	}
	return true
}

func emailFieldClass(invalid bool) string {
	if invalid { return emailFieldErrorClass }
	return emailFieldNeutralClass
}

// Conditional composition in Go does not introduce templ control-flow whitespace.
func emailFieldWhen(show bool, component templ.Component) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return err }
		if !show { return nil }
		return component.Render(ctx, w)
	})
}
